```python
import requests

def fetch_series(set_code, card_name):
    base = "https://api.mtgpricevault.com/v2/history"
    params = {
        "set": set_code,
        "card": card_name,
        "format": "paper_nonfoil",
        "original": "true"
    }
    r = requests.get(base, params=params, timeout=20)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    prices = [p[1] for p in data.get("series", [])]
    if not prices:
        return None, None
    return max(prices), min(prices)

cards = [
    ("ELD", "Oko, Thief of Crowns"),
    ("ELD", "Once Upon a Time"),
    ("M20", "Veil of Summer")
]

for set_code, name in cards:
    hi, lo = fetch_series(set_code, name)
    print(f"{name} ({set_code}): high={hi}, low={lo}")
```
